county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include the information of indoor and outdoor physical activity.

top_violation_types.title: Each caregiver, operation director, program director, and site director Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §744.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed as a follow-up and found deficient as one caregiver did not have documentation of current CPR training.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §744.1205(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that child was left unattended, and caregiver was not at a physical proximity which did not allow visual and/or auditory awareness of the child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio (26 TAC §744.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation exceeded the maximum group size for two or more caregivers.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information- Release Information (26 TAC §744.605(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children did not have the information of names and telephone numbers of persons other than a parent to whom the child may be released on file.

top_violation_types.title: Release of Children (26 TAC §744.2801)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A five year old child was released to another child under the age of 16 that is not designated on the child's admission form.

top_violation_types.title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §744.2803(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child was observed being released to someone who had not been identified by the operation. The operation failed to record the identity by a valid photo ID, or  license plate. The staff stood at the door during the release.

top_violation_types.title: Policies for Release of Children Instruct Employees of Verification Plan (26 TAC §744.2803(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff have not been trained on how to properly identify and release children.
